title: Insight-to-Story Editor I/O
description: Input/output contract for function 39. Turns a raw insight (often function 41's brief) into a narrative story draft closing with the roof line. Output is the post body as plain text, closing with the roof line.

proof_point.description: A client-free number, architecture fact or artefact. When no evidence has been documented yet, state that plainly here — the editor must flag the gap rather than fabricate a proof point.

campaign.description: utm_campaign value for the single call to action.

client_reference.description: Optional client name the caller wants named. Only used if docs/permission-register.yaml confirms CLEARED status; otherwise the story is written client-free.
